name: large-output-paging
prompt: Run ./build.sh. It prints one WARNING naming a deprecated dependency and the version to pin. Write that pin requirement, exactly as the warning states it, into PIN.txt.
notes: Six thousand lines of output with the one useful line at 2500, so it survives neither head- nor tail-truncation and has to be recovered from the spill file. This is the only task exercising the spill path and the instruction that points at it; a harness that truncates without saying where the rest went loses this outright.
